hero.title: Compliance, governance and cyber resilience
hero.text: Piqueou helps organizations achieve compliance and strengthen their digital governance. We help you prepare for and succeed in your CMMC, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIS2, Law 25 and GDPR certification efforts, while providing strategic support through a part-time CISO or CIO.

about.heading: A strategic partner for your compliance and cybersecurity
about.intro: Piqueou supports organizations in managing digital risk, achieving regulatory compliance and preparing for international cybersecurity certifications.
about.text: Our approach combines strategic expertise with hands-on operational support. We help businesses structure their IT governance, meet regulatory requirements and prepare effectively for audits and certifications such as CMMC, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIS2, Law 25 and GDPR.
about.counter_expertise: Complementary expertise: ITAR and controlled goods
services.subtitle: What we offer
services.frameworks.text: Strategic and operational support to achieve your certifications and meet regulatory requirements.
services.vciso.text: Access strategic cybersecurity and IT governance expertise without hiring a full-time executive.
services.grc.text: Implementation of governance and risk management frameworks to strengthen your cybersecurity posture.
services.audit.text: Complete preparation for compliance audits and support during official assessments.
services.regulatory.text: Aligning your organization with local and international regulatory requirements.
services.itar.title: Controlled Goods & ITAR
services.itar.text: Help structuring your process and obtaining authorizations under controlled goods and ITAR regulations.
pccc.title: Canadian Program for Cyber Security Certification (CPCSC)
services.pccc.text: Piqueou helps suppliers understand CPCSC requirements and protect sensitive information.
pmc.title: Controlled Goods
services.pmc.text: The CGP is a compliance requirement for certain sensitive goods in Canada. Piqueou helps clarify your obligations and simplify the process.
services.incident.text: Strategic intervention to manage cybersecurity incidents, limit impact and ensure business continuity.
process.subtitle: Project implementation methodology
process.text: Piqueou supports organizations in delivering their cybersecurity, compliance and IT governance projects with a structured, pragmatic and results-driven approach. Our methodology ensures efficient project execution, from initial analysis through ongoing control maintenance, while staying aligned with regulatory requirements and business objectives.
process.step1.title: Initial assessment
process.step1.text: Analysis of your IT environment, security posture and compliance level to identify gaps and priorities.
process.step2.title: Strategic planning
process.step2.text: Development of a clear roadmap covering priorities, required resources and project milestones.
process.step3.title: Implementation
process.step3.text: Deployment of the controls, policies and technical solutions needed for project success and compliance.
process.step4.title: Validation, audit & continuous improvement
process.step4.text: Compliance verification, evidence preparation and audit support, followed by performance monitoring and control adjustments to maintain compliance over time.
